newsitem.title: south korea: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - April 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - April 2.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- President Kim Young-sam and opposition leaders agreed on Tuesday to estabish a pan-national economic consulation body to draw up measures to overcome economic difficulties.

- Korea's trade deficit in the first quarter of this year swelled to $7.43 billion, recording a stunning $3.26 billion, or 78.3 percent, rise from a year earlier, according to the government's preliminary tally released on Tuesday.
- North Korean army and navy forces move towards the borders
with China, Japan's NHK Television said.
- President Kim Young-sam had dinner with Prime Minister Koh
Kun and other senior government officials at the premier's
residence near Blue House on Tuesday.
